name: Daily Binario
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Binario is a solo math game. Binario truly is a game of kings. A game which has lived on and been passed down through the ages for generations. It requires tactical skill and long term strategic choices. You must manage numbers and the factors in your multiple lines. On your top left, you'll want to use division and multiplication, but on your bottom rows, you'll be counting and subtracting. The only way to finish the game is to make sure all of your rows add up and the rows are neatly accounted for in the upper left rows. Four separate stacks. It's up to you to get it right! Do you have the same patience and pattern recognition abilities as generations of monarchs before you? In this version, there are three different levels of difficulty, easy, medium and hard. Each comes part and parcel with its own challenges and rewards. But ultimately the game remains the same: Sort the equations in as few moves as possible. It is truly a game that tests your mind as much as your reflexes or aim. Perhaps you have some royal blood in you.
